svg.title: Four bold eye designs on deep skin. Graphic wing: an eye-safe black liner along the upper lash line with a long, sharp wing, and a thin cyan line parallel above it ending in a dot. Floating crease: a magenta line that floats above the natural crease and ends in a point toward the brow tail, with a thin black liner. Dots under the brow: a row of white and gold dots following the curve just under each brow. Brow-bone color: a soft orange to magenta blend on the brow bone, sweeping out toward the temple.
